title: bug: a launch outage carried into a verified-local iteration never ends in moe-agent.ps1: the VM route turns every launch probe into a no-launch while the outage suppresses every claim (ps1 twin of task-cc4213c0)
description: Repro: a legacy-profile ps1 worker seat reaches 3 fast launch failures (LaunchOutage=true, task released); the project flips to verified-local (ready) while the wrapper lives; every later iteration prints MOE_LAUNCH_PROBE, then the VM route's taskless skip suppresses the probe, so the seat never claims again. Fix: port sh 8ca6a40b (task-cc4213c0): right after Invoke-MoeVerifiedLocalGate, when $script:MoeVmRoute -and $script:LaunchOutage, print the same [launch-outage] line, post one best-effort #general line and reset the six launch-success variables; port its postflight-vm-route row (and fake-proxy knob) to postflight-vm-route.ps1. Hand-forward: comment from architect-1dd28c7c on task-62ec51f1 (CQ-M07n), which lands the ps1 outage exemption.
definitionOfDone: moe-agent.ps1 ends a carried-over launch outage on the first VM-route iteration with the sh twin's strings (8ca6a40b), resetting the streak, backoff and four outage variables
A postflight-vm-route.ps1 row reproduces the carry-over (legacy outage, then verified-local ready) and proves the seat claims again with no host CLI launch
postflight-vm-route.ps1 passes on powershell.exe and pwsh.exe; parity-check.sh passes; moe-agent.ps1 keeps its UTF-8 BOM
